description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Prestigious Home:* Spacious Balcony and Porches* Walking/Biking Distance to Grayton Beach Tram Stop and the Beach* Close to Public Grayton Dunes Beach Access or Grayton Beach State Park* 4 Bikes* 100 feet to Resort Style, Zero-Entry Pool with Clubhouse* Walk to Hurricane Oyster Bar and Grayton Corner Café* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* Welcome to Casita Grayton, a stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home that comfortably sleeps 9 guests. From the moment you arrive, you'll be welcomed by a charming entrance that sets the tone for the coastal elegance and beauty that defines this home. The first floor features an open-concept living and entertainment area, complete with a fully equipped kitchen. It also includes the first king master bedroom and a luxurious bathroom with a walk-in shower and a large soaking tub—perfect for unwinding. A sleeper sofa in the living room offers additional sleeping space. On the second floor, you'll find the second king master bedroom, complete with a private ensuite bathroom, walk-in shower, and a spacious balcony where you can savor your morning coffee. The second floor also features a kid-friendly bunk room with a twin over full bed, ideal for play and games. Another bedroom on this level offers 2 twin beds, separated by a beautiful barn-style sliding door for added privacy. Relax on the porch or balcony or take a short stroll to the community pool just steps away. For your convenience, we have 2 beach chairs, an umbrella, and toys for your use in the garage. Start creating unforgettable memories at Casita Grayton today!The Village at Grayton Beach is a new community of 47 coastal beach cottages accented with upscale touches, just minutes from the iconic white sand beaches of 30A. The Village is near Western Lake and Grayton State Park, perfect for launching paddleboards! The neighborhood features a resort-style, zero-entry pool with a sun deck and pool house. Within walking distance to several local bars and eateries, this community offers all the best of 30A without all the hustle and bustle. Come experience The Village at Grayton Beach and see why you’ll be returning year after year! The Bed Setup:1st FloorMaster Bedroom #1: King BedLivingroom: Sleeper Sofa2nd FloorMaster Bedroom #2: King Bed Guest Bedroom: Twin over Full Bunk BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin BedsArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. Grayton Beach not only provides you with stunning views, it provides you with activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here!Grayton Beach is a funky, free-spirited town where you will find quaint historic cottages next to modern beach homes. Among the curving live oaks you'll find this unique beach town dotted with coastal dune lakes and bounded by Point Washington State Forest and Grayton State Beach Park. Explore clever artwork from local artisans and several local dining options. There is a laid back vibe here that may be explained by one of the local bumper stickers that says, "Grayton Beach: Nice Dogs, Strange People". Unusual and eclectic, this is a beach town you will not want to miss.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
